explained.summary: If someone has done wrong, the harm falls on them, not you. And perhaps they haven’t done wrong at all. Two quick checks before you get upset: whose problem is it, and are you even sure it happened?
explained.today: The friend who didn’t reply to your message may be ill or busy, not snubbing you. And if they really are being rude, that’s a mark on their character, not yours.
